instruction: Make the offsets of `Text.stylize(style, start=0, end=None)` (rich/text.py) keyword-only: `stylize(style, *, start=0, end=None)`, so `text.stylize("bold", 0, 5)` must be written `text.stylize("bold", start=0, end=5)`. Leave `stylize_before` unchanged. Update every caller that passes `start` or `end` positionally.
notes: Seeded 2026-10-05 on the current tip. Gold = AST rewrite of positional start/end to keywords. examples/rainbow.py is the one caller no test imports.
patch:

@@ -13,7 +13,7 @@ from rich.highlighter import Highlighter

         for index in range(len(text)):
-            text.stylize(f"color({randint(16, 255)})", index, index + 1)
+            text.stylize(f"color({randint(16, 255)})", start=index, end=index + 1)
